your_games.title: 🪓 Valheim patch 1.0.30 makes failed Forge of Potential upgrades far less painful
your_games.body: Iron Gate's latest patch makes the Forge of Potential return substantially more materials when an upgrade fails, rebalances idol drop rates so they turn up more evenly, and stops seeding its RNG on character names. It also fixes players getting stuck in portals in multiplayer, adds a 'Brighten dark environment' accessibility setting and music in the Sunken Crypt. It affects crossplay, so everyone in your group needs to update before connecting.

your_games.title: 🦋 Team Cherry will share Silksong's Sea of Sorrow DLC update on Friday
your_games.body: A Cherry Time! broadcast on YouTube on Friday 27 November at 7am PT (5pm SAST) promises "a bunch of exciting announcements" plus an update on Hollow Knight: Silksong's free Sea of Sorrow expansion.

your_games.title: ⚔️ Xenoblade Chronicles 3's Switch 2 Edition adds 4K, 60fps and a new Hero on 3 December
your_games.body: Nintendo's new overview trailer runs through the upgrade: 4K in TV mode, improved 60fps performance, a new Heroes' Vault mode, a new Hero called Shimmer, and event scenes now fully voiced in English and Japanese. Existing Switch owners can buy the upgrade pack for £7.99 ($9.99).

your_games.title: 🐉 Dragon Quest Monsters: The Withered World gets its final trailer ahead of 3 December
your_games.body: Square Enix's monster-raising RPG has you befriending, synthesising and battling Dragon Quest monsters, which follow you around the world regardless of size. It launches on PS5, Xbox Series, Switch 2, Switch and PC next Thursday, and a demo is out now.

your_games.title: 😈 Diablo 4 Season 16 keeps Old Tristram and Deckard Cain for good from 1 December
your_games.body: Season of Tyrael's Gambit starts on 1 December, and Blizzard is making much of Season 15's Diablo 2 anniversary content permanent: Old Tristram, Deckard Cain, the Prime Evil Council as a Lair Boss, Waking Nightmares, Legacy Uniques and even Cow Island.

your_games.title: 🎁 Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 3 + 4 leads December's PS Plus Essential games
your_games.body: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 3 + 4 and Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2 (PS5 and PS4) and Amnesia: The Bunker (PS4) are available to PS Plus Essential members from 1 December.

your_games.title: 🐝 Yooka-Laylee and the Impossible Lair gets a free Definitive Edition upgrade on 15 December
your_games.body: Playtonic's 2.5D platformer comes to PS5, Switch 2 and Steam with 4K at 120fps on PS5, a 120fps mode on Switch 2, better lighting and shadows, two orchestrated soundtracks and the Trowzer's Top Tonic Pack DLC. Existing owners upgrade for free.

your_games.title: 🐴 Zelda: Ocarina of Time on Switch 2 fixes the stuck Malon's Friend event
your_games.body: Version 1.1.2 fixes the issue that stopped the Malon's Friend event progressing, even on saves that have already hit it, along with several other fixes for smoother play.

industry.title: Unreal Engine 6 will drop Blueprints and the Actor Gameplay Framework
industry.body: Epic's EVP of Development Marcus Wassmer says UE6 will be Verse-first on the new Scene Graph framework, reversing June's promise that Blueprints and Actors would coexist. Epic expects AI to make converting UE5 projects practical, saying it ported Fortnite Battle Royale's 20,000-plus Blueprints to about 3 million lines of Verse in a prototype.

industry.title: CD Projekt says The Witcher 4 launches on PS5, Xbox and PC at the same time
industry.body: After this week's Sony marketing deal, joint CEO Michał Nowakowski said The Witcher 4 and its other upcoming games stay multiplatform: "All the platforms release at the same time – PS5, XB, and PC. No one gets left behind." Switch 2 wasn't mentioned, and the game is still slated for 2028.

industry.title: GTA VI has PS5s sold out at major US retailers before Black Friday
industry.body: PS Direct and many big US retailers are out of stock, and Sony is running no hardware promotions this Black Friday. Circana's Mat Piscatella says US PS5 unit sales were more than 2.4x the same week last year in the run-up to launch.

industry.title: Ubisoft reportedly makes teams justify not using generative AI in pitches
industry.body: Sources told Vertical Slice that new game pitches must outline how generative AI will be used, and teams that don't want to use it need a reason. It follows Ubisoft launching its Motherbrain AI subsidiary last week.
